findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/BigOperators/Finsupp/Basic.lean:271 `finsetSum_apply (S) (f) (a) : (∑ i ∈ S, f i) a = ∑ i ∈ S, f i a`, exactly the stated goal at Finset.univ.
findings.issue: The local `sum_apply` lemma reimplements Mathlib's `Finsupp.finsetSum_apply` via a manual `Finset.induction_on`; this hides a reusable existing fact and is brittle (its `change`/`induction`/`simp` script breaks on refactors).

findings.evidence: Lines 54–55 and 65–66 use `change` with no justifying comment; the second unfolds the anonymous-constructor `coeff` field by definitional equality.
findings.fix: Reach the if-form via explicit lemmas (`Finsupp.single_apply`, `Finsupp.coe_mk`, `Subtype.ext_iff`) or add a comment stating why no rewrite reaches the goal.
findings.issue: Undocumented `change` (also line 54) reshapes the goal into `if ... then 1 else 0 = ∑ ..., if (i:G) = x then 1 else 0`, relying on accidental defeq through `Finsupp.coe_mk`/`Finsupp.single_apply`. The rubric flags any `change`/`show` without a comment and any reliance on cross-coercion defeq.

findings.evidence: classSum (lines 26–35) is defined in tactic mode via `by_cases`, so `rw [classSum, dif_pos hk]` matches the compiled `dite`; any change to the definition's shape breaks this proof.
findings.fix: Prove a `classSum_coeff`/`classSum_apply` characterization lemma once and use it here, so downstream proofs never unfold the raw definition or its `dif_pos`.
findings.issue: `rw [classSum, dif_pos hk, ...]` unfolds the tactic-built definition and depends on the exact `dite` term emitted by the `by_cases Nontrivial k` in `classSum`'s body; this is fragile reliance on the elaborated definition rather than a stable characterization lemma.

summary: The classSum_eq_sum proof hand-rolls a Mathlib lemma via induction and leans on two undocumented `change` steps that unfold coercions by defeq. Replace the reinvented helper and document or eliminate the defeq manipulations.
